what_worked: Visually polished deck with consistent branding, clear hierarchy, and readable before/after bar charts on slides 4–5.
fix_next: Use the assigned 1,000-row dataset; every claim must trace to that data, not unsourced industry assertions.
verdict: A consulting pitch for Meesho, not a data story from the assigned dataset.

evidence.insight: Zero analytical findings from the assigned 1,000-row dataset. All claims (RTO 20-30%, last-mile 40-55%, AOV ≈₹350) are generic industry assertions about Meesho logistics with no derivation shown.
evidence.narrative: Internally coherent three-act consulting pitch (problem → unit economics → VAANI solution), but it is entirely disconnected from any assigned data-story task. No analytical question is posed or answered with data.
evidence.framing: Framed as a Meesho strategy case for an internal audience. No mention of the 1,000-row dataset, its variables, missingness, or any scope/limitation relevant to the assigned task. A cold reader would not know this was a data-story assignment.
evidence.accuracy: No claims reference the frozen dataset, so none can be verified against it. Industry figures (COD ~75%, RTO 20-30%, pickup adoption <10%) are stated without citations. Slide 5 fine print concedes numbers are 'indicative and based on internal estimates'—effectively admitting fabrication. ₹300 Cr savings is an unsubstantiated projection.
evidence.visual: Professional Meesho-branded template with consistent pink/magenta palette, clear icon usage, readable bar charts (slides 4-5), and good visual hierarchy. Slide 4 is dense but navigable. However, charts illustrate assumed/estimated figures rather than analyzed data.
evidence.ai_slop: Heavy consulting jargon throughout: 'Re-Architecting Last-Mile Through Trust, Density & Behavioural Design,' 'distributed commerce ecosystem,' 'layered logistics architecture for Bharat.' Decorative icons and slogans dominate over any analytical content.

change_reason: Lowered framing from 1.5 to 1.0; the deck makes zero reference to the assigned dataset, its schema, or any analytical scope—worse than merely weak framing. All other scores confirmed as appropriate.
